Market today: The S&P 500 is in a correction, signaling broad market weakness. This mood, coupled with concerns about tech concentration, is the real driver for your chip-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-84.61%) and MUU (-72.49%) are in deep drawdowns, amplified by their leveraged nature and decay. CRWD (+19.53%) is a strong performer but flagged "SELL" by the scanner. Remember margin amplifies drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the broader market's reaction to the S&P 500 correction and any further news on tech sector sentiment.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and re-evaluate your leveraged, deeply underwater positions.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming SOXL given its -84.61% loss and leveraged decay; its stop at 200 is far from the current 34.58.
MUU: Review MUU, down -72.49% and leveraged; its stop at 31.6 is well above the current 10.23.
CRWD: CRWD is a strong performer at +19.53%, but the scanner flags 'SELL'; consider trimming to lock in gains or re-evaluate its stop at 147.5.
